name: Lesson 5 · Link and cash in
intro: Tricks chain until you wipe out or cash in. Bank before the wave gets you.

goals.hint: Link three turns without falling, then press Enter (R3) to bank them
goals.hintClassic: Land three tricks back to back, then press Enter (R3) to bank the chain

goals.hint: Fill the meter until it flashes, then reverse your rail mid-turn for a roundhouse
goals.hintClassic: Fill the meter until it flashes, then pull your special (see the Trick Book)
